weather_simulated_part.label: weather_simulated
weather_simulated_part.method: Interpolate station-minus-model residuals between anchors <=12h apart; taper nearest residual to zero over 3h at gap edges; add to hourly interpolated model; small seeded correlated noise zero at full hours; round 0.1. Distant gaps use model. Future uses forecast, never sensor.
